did: You chose no excuses for errors the server silently drops, and I built it. A second clippy pass now forces the three erasure lints through every allow and expect, reasoned or not, so none can hide one. The check holds that pass against a list of the 830 that exist today, which can only shrink, and the older clippy list stays at 887 with no finding counted twice. It replaced #1194's reading of the source text, which kept leaking at its edges. A fresh review before the pull request found three real gaps, and Codex then found none. It merged as server#1204, closing #1202.
left: The clippy ratchet folds every use of a macro into one finding, the same gap this check fixed for itself (server#1203).
Forcing the lints also shows other policies under their allows, so the forced pass runs on its own, about a minute and a half more of CI.
